WITH year_total AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type,
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY d_year) > 0
            THEN SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) / LAG(SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY d_year)
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS growth_ratio
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type,
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY d_year) > 0
            THEN SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) / LAG(SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY d_year)
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS growth_ratio
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
store_1998 AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1998 AND year_total > 0
),
store_1999 AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1998 + 1
),
web_1998 AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998 AND year_total > 0
),
web_1999 AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998 + 1
)
SELECT
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM store_1998 AS t_s_firstyear
JOIN web_1998 AS t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN store_1999 AS t_s_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_secyear.customer_id
JOIN web_1999 AS t_w_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
WHERE
    t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
    AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
    AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
    AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's'
    AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w'
    AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's'
    AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
    AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
    AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
    AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND t_w_secyear.growth_ratio > t_s_secyear.growth_ratio
ORDER BY
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
